title: Strings that contain a carriage return
notes: A raw carriage return in a document is a line break and is read as a line feed, so a writer escapes it (`\r`) in a double-quoted scalar. This is a writing convention of the family, not the specification: a string is written plain only when every common reader reads it as that same string, so the text is judged under the YAML 1.2 Core schema (loose) and also under YAML 1.1 and the number forms common readers accept (strict).
